headline: Sensex jumps over 500 points and Nifty nears 25,300 driven by FII inflows and FMCG gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) staged a record November comeback, providing strong buying support.
Rally in major heavyweights including FMCG and banking stocks boosted benchmark indices.
Dalal Street emerged as the best-performing stock market over the past month.
Strong early-session momentum pushed Nifty past key resistance levels above 25,300.
whatHappening: Sensex closed up by over 510 points while Nifty50 settled near 25,291.
Coal India announced plans to use MCL IPO proceeds towards its ₹1 trillion diversification strategy.
Sebi established a sub-group under PMAC, headed by NSE's Chauhan, to review key IPO norms.
Max Healthcare emerged as the top gainer among index stocks during the trading session.
summary: Indian benchmark indices registered strong gains on November 16, with the Sensex surging over 500 points and Nifty nearing 25,300. Foreign portfolio investors led a record November comeback, providing firm market support alongside gains in FMCG and banking sectors. Key individual stock developments included Coal India announcing a ₹1 trillion diversification plan and Max Healthcare leading the gainers list.
